mapper.sql: id, group_no, cmd_data, create_time, clear_date, request_id
mapper.select: SELECT cil.id, cil.group_no, cil.cmd_data, cil.create_time, cil.clear_date, cil.request_id FROM clear_issue_log cil JOIN ( SELECT group_no, clear_date, MAX(id) as max_id FROM clear_issue_log where clear_date between #{startDate,jdbcType=DATE} and #{endDate,jdbcType=DATE} GROUP BY group_no, clear_date ) subquery ON cil.id = subquery.max_id AND cil.group_no = subquery.group_no AND cil.clear_date = subquery.clear_date;
